about: Song ladder (PLAN 8.3), Levels 1-8. A song is done at 100% speed with a score of 80 or more (play along; Level 1 also in wait mode), the whole song, the hands in 'hands'. A level is done when all its songs are done. Each skill moment stops the song at 'at_beat' and the song goes on from 'resume_beat' (PLAN 8.2). Titles use plain words: the user sees them before the unlock.

levels.title: First songs
levels.text: Use your right hand. Your hand stays in one place most of the time.

levels.title: Play with the click
levels.text: Play at a steady speed. The app can play the left hand for you.

levels.title: The left hand joins
levels.text: Play with your left hand. Then play with both hands. Thin lines across the notes help you count.

levels.title: Move and black keys
levels.text: Move your hand to new places. Play your first black key. Learn the names of the black keys.

levels.title: Keys together
levels.text: Your left hand plays 3 keys together. Some sound happy and some sound sad.

levels.title: Patterns that repeat
levels.text: Many songs use the same few groups of keys again and again. Play the same pattern in a new place on the keyboard.

levels.title: Longer runs
levels.text: Play more than 5 keys in a row. Your thumb goes under your hand, and a finger goes over your thumb.

levels.title: Rhythm patterns
levels.text: Your left hand plays patterns. Learn two rhythms from Indian music: one of 4 clicks and one of 6 clicks.
